decision_cruda.rationale: C512-12 stopped 5-8h, so LH-04 is idle and can activate a reserve (RESERVE-01). Central trucks have spare capacity (inflow 63 vs 91 t/h), and the stockpile is at 147 of 450 t. RS-C564-02 has 278 t at 8.9 g/t and loads at 38.5 t/h with an LH514. After 0.5 h activation and the lunch break, about 6 loading hours gives roughly 230 t, or about 66 oz. RS-C512-01 gives roughly 57 oz. RS-N574-03 is at truck-limited Norte and only 5.8 g/t. No loans, because taking a loader from a producing place or from critical-path development costs more than it gains.
